description: Two-panel solvus diagram (pseudo-binary phase-field map vs composition and temperature) for Fe-Mn-Al-C alloys. Both panels share the y-axis Temperature (°C), 500 to 900 with 50 °C ticks. (a) has x-axis Al (wt%), 4 to 11; (b) has x-axis Mn (wt%), 22 to 30. Each panel contains a solid line bordering the upper γ (austenite) field, a dashed line bordering the middle field labelled γ+κ*, and a lower field labelled γ+κ*+κ'. (a) is for Fe-30Mn-xAl-1C: the solid γ line rises from about 735 °C at Al ≈ 5.3 wt% to about 840 °C at Al ≈ 10 wt%, and the dashed line rises steeply from about 530 °C (Al ≈ 6) to about 735 °C (Al ≈ 10); marker sets (×, open ○, filled ●) are plotted at Al ≈ 5.3, 7.0 and 10 wt%. (b) is for Fe-xMn-7Al-1C: the solid γ line falls only slightly, from about 810 °C at Mn ≈ 23.5 to about 765 °C at Mn ≈ 29.3, and the dashed line falls from about 690 to about 670 °C; points are shown only at Mn ≈ 23.5 and 29.3 wt%. No legend key and no numeric data labels are printed. The figure demonstrates that Al strongly raises the κ-carbide solvus whereas Mn lowers it only slightly.

observations.observation: Panel (a) plots Temperature (°C) from 500 to 900 versus Al (wt%) from 4 to 11; panel (b) plots the same temperature range versus Mn (wt%) from 22 to 30.
Panel (a) contains three labelled fields stacked vertically: γ at the top, γ+κ* in the middle and γ+κ*+κ' at the bottom.
In panel (a) the solid boundary of the γ field rises with Al content, from about 735 °C at Al ≈ 5.3 wt% to about 840 °C at Al ≈ 10 wt%.
In panel (a) the dashed boundary of the γ+κ* field rises steeply, from about 530 °C near Al ≈ 6 wt% to about 735 °C at Al ≈ 10 wt%.

In panel (b) both boundaries are nearly flat or slightly decreasing with Mn content: the solid γ line from about 810 °C at Mn ≈ 23.5 to about 765 °C at Mn ≈ 29.3 wt%, and the dashed line from about 690 to about 670 °C.

Data points are drawn with three marker types — crosses (×), open circles (○) and filled circles (●) — at three Al levels in (a) and only two Mn levels in (b); no legend key is printed in either panel.
The caption states the two panels refer to (a) Fe-30Mn-xAl-1C and (b) Fe-xMn-7Al-1C alloys.

The caption states that the figure shows the effects of Al and Mn contents on the solvus of the κ phase, and identifies γ as austenite with intragranular and intergranular κ-carbide distinguished (marker-to-phase assignment not visible in the panels).
The citing text states that Al addition raises the solvus of both intergranular and intragranular κ-carbides significantly, while Mn addition causes only a slight reduction of the solvus.
The citing text states the compositions studied span Fe-(21–32)Mn-(2–10)Al-1C steels.
The citation for this figure is given as reference [128].

subfigures.description: Solvus/phase-field plot for Fe-30Mn-xAl-1C: y = Temperature (°C) 500-900, x = Al (wt%) 4-11. Regions labelled γ (top), γ+κ* (middle) and γ+κ*+κ' (bottom), separated by a solid line (rising from ~735 to ~840 °C) and a dashed line (rising from ~530 to ~735 °C). Data markers ×, open ○ and filled ● plotted at Al ≈ 5.3, 7.0 and 10 wt%.

Solvus/phase-field plot for Fe-xMn-7Al-1C: y = Temperature (°C) 500-900, x = Mn (wt%) 22-30. Same region labels γ, γ+κ*, γ+κ*+κ'; the solid line descends slightly from ~810 to ~765 °C and the dashed line from ~690 to ~670 °C. Markers ×, ○, ● plotted only at Mn ≈ 23.5 and 29.3 wt%.

unreadable_items: No legend/key printed in either panel linking the markers ×, ○ and ● to specific κ-carbide types or to the γ/κ* solvus boundaries
Caption symbol text is OCR-corrupted ('j' standing for κ and 'κ?'), so the exact printed carbide labels (κ0 / κ′) are uncertain
No numeric values are printed on the curves or data points; all temperature readings are interpolated from gridlines
